components.name: ipfs_kit_py
components.role: Artifact authority: immutable artifacts, CAS, WAL, current pointers
assumptions: Hermetic/conditional/live distinctions and candidate/admitted/current proof roles are reference semantics to adapt, not weaken.
Zero live-qualified backends is a valid honest state and must not be relabeled as live.

components.name: ipfs_datasets_py
assumptions: Package import must not enable installation or ambient mutation on assurance paths.
MIT/AGPL declaration conflict remains unresolved_human_legal_review.

components.name: SwissKnife
assumptions: Browser state must never originate authority; host independently evaluates authenticated request fields.
Missing license/provenance remains human-blocked.

components.name: Mcp-Plus-Plus
components.role: Normative FCA ownership, schemas, and cross-language contracts
assumptions: Hand-maintained duplicate semantics are inventory conflicts until CCC selects DAG-CBOR source of truth.
MCP++ owns normative claim semantics; repository adapters cannot broaden them.
Python and TypeScript are not whole-program proof targets; they consume verified bindings and translation-validated artifacts.
A missing optional formal tool yields a typed capability gap; it never triggers import-time or worker-time installation and never produces simulated proof.
Provider/LLM output is proposal-only; validation, merge, goal completion, release, and authority remain deterministic or externally reviewed.
Exact committed gitlinks in the clean controller worktree are the only source authority for inventories and TCB qualification.
Discovery of defects or reusable components is not remediation completion.
